title: Mediterranean Artichoke, Chicken, and Farro Bowls
intro: This bright, lemony bowl delivers steady afternoon energy by pairing lean protein with high-fiber farro and vegetables. Relying on simple pantry staples helps you assemble a satisfying lunch without turning on the stove.

ingredients.name: No-salt-added canned chicken breast
ingredients.canonical_name: Chicken, canned, meat only, no salt added

ingredients.name: No-salt-added canned quartered artichoke hearts (in water)
ingredients.canonical_name: Artichokes, (globe or french), cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

ingredients.name: Cherry tomatoes
ingredients.canonical_name: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

instructions: Warm the farro according to the package instructions.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and chop the parsley while the farro warms.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper together in a large mixing bowl.
Add the warm farro, drained chicken, drained artichoke hearts, tomatoes, and parsley to the bowl.
Toss to combine, breaking the chicken apart into bite-sized chunks.
Divide the mixture between plates to serve immediately, or pack into containers for a cold lunch.
variation: Trade the canned chicken for drained light tuna in water.
conservation: Keeps 3 days refrigerated in an airtight container; serve cold.
